tagline.en: EO-Robotics' EO-1 — a 3B embodied vision-language-action model that predicts robot actions from images and instructions.
tagline.zh: EO-Robotics 的 EO-1——3B 规模的具身视觉-语言-动作模型,依据图像与指令预测机器人动作。

en: EO-1 is an embodied vision-language-action (VLA) model from EO-Robotics. It reads visual observations and a natural-language instruction and produces the actions a robot should take.

The released checkpoint, EO-1-3B, is a 3-billion-parameter model built on a Transformers backbone. WorldFoundry drives it through a lightweight action-selection adapter, so a policy rollout is a matter of feeding observations and reading back the chosen action.
In WorldFoundry you point EO-1 at your local checkpoint and run it for action prediction or policy rollout without additional glue code.
zh: EO-1 是 EO-Robotics 推出的具身视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它读取视觉观测与一条自然语言指令,输出机器人应当执行的动作。
已发布的 checkpoint 为 EO-1-3B,是一个 30 亿参数、构建在 Transformers 主干上的模型。WorldFoundry 通过一个轻量的动作选择适配器驱动它,因此做一次策略 rollout 只需喂入观测、读回所选动作即可。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把 EO-1 指向本地 checkpoint,无需额外胶水代码即可运行动作预测或策略 rollout。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want a compact, general-purpose embodied VLA policy to drive a robot from images and language instructions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个紧凑、通用的具身 VLA 策略,依据图像与语言指令来驱动机器人时,它很合适。

notFor.en: It produces robot actions, not video or images. You'll need to download the checkpoint separately and have a matching robot or simulator to act on the outputs.
notFor.zh: 它产出的是机器人动作,而非视频或图像。你需要单独下载 checkpoint,并准备好可执行这些输出的匹配机器人或仿真器。

en: Maps images and instructions to robot actions
Runs through a Transformers action-selection adapter
zh: 来自 EO-Robotics 的具身 VLA 策略
已发布 30 亿参数 checkpoint(EO-1-3B)
将图像与指令映射为机器人动作
通过 Transformers 动作选择适配器运行
